newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA 5-mth oper prof up 29.2 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: CA 5-mth oper prof up 29.2 pct - report.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein boosted its operating profit by 29.2 percent in the first five months of this year, Vienna daily Wiener Zeitung quoted the bank's chief executive Erich Hampel as saying on Thursday.
No one at Austria's second biggest bank was immediately available to confirm the report. The newspaper gave no comparative figures.
Hampel traced much of the rise to a significant improvement in the bank's trading result, according to Wiener Zeitung.
Private and business customers had given "a spontaneous display of loyalty" following Creditanstalt's takeover by former rival Bank Austria in January, he added.
In April, Creditanstalt reported a record group first quarter operating profit of 2.11 billion schillings, 31 percent up on the previous year.
